blocks.text: Interior design project for an apartment in Bratislava with a total area of 58 m²

parts.html: Interior design studio DUMSKAYA DESIGN developed a comprehensive interior design project for a 58 m² apartment in Bratislava.

The project included the full scope of work needed to create a contemporary and functional living space: developing the design project, preparing technical documentation, designing and manufacturing custom furniture, professional decorating, and carrying out a complete turnkey renovation.

The design covers all of the apartment’s main rooms: the living room, bedroom, kitchen with custom-designed storage systems and built-in appliances, walk-in closets, entrance hall, and bathroom. Custom furniture solutions were developed for each area, including built-in wardrobes, shelving, and functional storage systems.

With a floor area of 58 m², particular attention was paid to making efficient use of every square meter. The layout and furniture solutions make it possible to organize the space effectively and provide ample storage while preserving the feeling of an open, visually light interior.

Before the renovation began, the client received a detailed cost estimate covering construction and finishing work, materials, the manufacture of custom furniture, and appliances. This made it possible to determine the main costs in advance and plan the stages of the project’s implementation.

To give a clear picture of the future interior, photorealistic 3D visualizations were prepared, showing the planned materials, furniture, lighting, color schemes, and the overall atmosphere of the apartment.

DUMSKAYA DESIGN provides interior design for apartments and private houses, develops custom furniture, and delivers comprehensive turnkey renovation projects in Bratislava and other cities in Slovakia.
